transaction_description: Joint large-holding filing by Hikari Tsushin, UH Partners 2 and UH Partners 3 as kyodo hoyusha. UH Partners 3 at 7.27 percent, 2381100 shares. Reporting obligation date 19 September 2025, filed to EDINET 29 September 2025.
recording_date_basis: GEM release trace confirmed by the newest_update stamp
salience_note: Recent. Listed Japanese issuer with a statutory disclosure deadline, so the event is dated and public within days.

transaction_description: Vistra completed the acquisition of seven natural gas plants, about 2600 MW, from Lotus Infrastructure Partners for 1.9bn USD. Announced 20 May 2025, completed 22 October 2025. Syracuse, 103 MW, New York, is one of the seven.
salience_note: Recent and large. A 1.9bn USD acquisition by a listed US utility, announced and completed with investor-relations coverage.

transaction_description: Dodge and Cox cut State Street from about 6.9 percent to 3.200 percent, minus 10959082 shares, minus 53.68 percent. 13G filed 13 November 2024 for a transaction dated 30 September 2024. The March 2025 release still showed 6.6 percent.
recording_date_basis: GEM release trace, the edge is absent by this release
salience_note: Institutional holding, not a corporate transaction. Also a disclosure-threshold artefact: below the 5 percent 13G bar the holding leaves the data entirely.

transaction_description: A Castleton Commodities International subsidiary acquired a majority stake in the 674 MW New Salem Harbor CCGT. Footprint Power Salem Harbor Development LP had filed Chapter 11 on 23 March 2022. Same GEM entity ID throughout, renamed and re-parented.
recording_date_basis: Twelve consecutive releases carried the old owner, then July 2026 carried the new one. Stamp agrees.
salience_note: Older and less prominent. A single distressed plant sold by a bankrupt owner to a private commodities firm.

transaction_description: Fluxys increased its stake in the Dutch BBL interconnector from 20 percent to 25 percent.
recording_date_basis: GEM release trace. The stamp precedes the carrying release by four months.
salience_note: Older and less prominent. A five-point stake change in a bilateral gas interconnector, announced by the acquirer only.

transaction_description: VINCI completed the acquisition of the ACS energy business Cobra IS on 31 December 2021, agreement signed 1 April 2021, 4.9bn EUR. Initec Energia is an ACS industrial-division company inside the Cobra perimeter that passed to VINCI.
salience_note: Oldest in the sample. A large transaction, but the affected entity is a subsidiary several layers below the headline deal, and the ownership change reaches it only by perimeter.
